name: CULane
description: : Lane detection, as a crucial task in autonomous driving systems, faces the dual challenges of robustness and accuracy in complex road environments. This study conducts a comparative analysis of three representative deep learning models — Spatial Convolutional Neural Network (SCNN), Point Instance Network (PINet), and LaneATT. The models are reproduced and evaluated under consistent input settings using the unified CUHK Lane Dataset (CULane) and a standardized evaluation tool. Both quantitative metrics and visualized results are utilized to assess each model’s detection performance across diverse driving scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that LaneATT achieves the best overall performance, particularly exhibiting strong robustness in challenging conditions such as nighttime and shadowed environments.
